questions.text: On the occasion of its 23rd Foundation Day, which of the following is the primary purpose of the AI-Powered WHOIS Screening Platform launched by the National Internet Exchange of India (NIXI)?

options.text: To manage the auctioning process of premium .IN domain names
To facilitate domain registrations in 22 different Indian languages
To enhance domain name security and strengthen the detection of suspicious websites
To track and promote the adoption of IPv6 across India's internet ecosystem
To provide real-time analytics on internet traffic and user demographics for websites using .IN domains

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is To enhance domain name security and strengthen the detection of suspicious websites

In News

  • The National Internet Exchange of India (NIXI) celebrated its 23rd Foundation Day on June 19, 2026.
  • On this occasion, the Secretary of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) launched four new digital initiatives to boost transparency and security in India's internet ecosystem.

Key Points

  • AI-Powered WHOIS Screening Platform: This specific platform was launched to enhance domain name security and strengthen the detection of suspicious websites, thereby securing the .in domain space.
  • The other three portals launched include the IX Portal, myIRINN Portal, and the .IN Auction Portal.
  • These initiatives aim to improve operational efficiency, transparency, and monitoring processes across the internet infrastructure in India.
  • Hence, the correct option is the one related to security and detection of suspicious activity.

Additional Information

  • NIXI currently manages over 39 lakh+ .IN domain names.
  • It operates 79 Internet Exchange Points (IXPs) across India.
  • India has reached approximately 78.34% IPv6 adoption, making it a global leader in this transition.
  • NIXI also supports domain registrations in 22 Indian languages to make the internet more inclusive.

Important Points

  • NIXI is a not-for-profit organization under the aegis of MeitY.
  • It manages the .IN and .भारत (.Bharat) country-code top-level domains.
  • The initiatives align with the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047, focusing on internet resilience and a secure digital ecosystem.

questions.text: What is the total financial outlay approved by the Central Government for the umbrella scheme SARTHAK-PDS for the next five years?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Rs. 25,530 crore

In News

  • The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA), chaired by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved the integration and continuation of two schemes under the umbrella scheme SARTHAK-PDS.

Key Points

  • Financial Outlay: The Central Government has sanctioned an outlay of Rs. 25,530 crore as the Central share for the SARTHAK-PDS scheme for the next five years.
  • Integration of Schemes: The umbrella scheme integrates "Assistance to State Agencies for intra-State movement of foodgrains and FPS dealers’ margin under NFSA" and the "Scheme for Modernization and Reforms through Technology in Public Distribution System (SMART PDS)".
  • Implementation Period: The merged scheme is set to operate during the 16th Finance Commission cycle award period and will remain functional up to 31.03.2031.
  • Beneficiaries: The initiative aims to support the government's commitment to provide food and nutritional security to 81.35 crore persons covered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA), 2013.

Additional Information

  • Full Form: SARTHAK-PDS stands for Scheme for Assistance in Ration Transport and Handling-Income with Automation in PDS.
  • Technological Focus: The scheme seeks to optimize PDS operations using advanced technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Blockchain.
  • Modernization: It includes the creation of State Command Control Centres for data-driven oversight and ISO-certified process frameworks to ensure transparency and security.

Important Points

  • The core goal of SARTHAK-PDS is to ensure last-mile service delivery, minimize leakages, and provide assured financial support for handling and FPS dealer's margins.
  • Since 1st April 2023, the SMART PDS scheme has enabled complete digitization of ration cards and FPS automation through e-PoS across 36 States/UTs.

questions.text: Which initiative was awarded the 2026 Food Planet Prize, the world’s largest environmental award for food systems, receiving a prize of USD 1.5 million?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is AP Community Managed Natural Farming (APCNF)

In News

  • The AP Community Managed Natural Farming (APCNF) programme has won the prestigious 2026 Food Planet Prize for its nature-positive global farming model.

Key Points

  • The Food Planet Prize is considered the world’s largest environmental award focused on transforming global food systems.
  • The award, worth USD 1.5 million (approximately Rs 14 crore), was presented by the Curt Bergfors Foundation on June 2 in Båstad, Sweden.
  • APCNF emerged as the winner among four global finalists. The other three finalists—Conscious Kitchen (US), NoPalm Ingredients (Netherlands), and Savanna Institute (US)—received USD 150,000 each.
  • The jury praised APCNF for its nature-positive model, which has helped 1.8 million farmers in 8,000 villages adopt natural farming over the last decade.

Additional Information

  • Executive Vice Chairman T Vijay Kumar attributed the success to women’s Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and rural communities.
  • Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu hailed the award as a first for India.
  • The programme is recognized as one of the world’s largest agroecology movements.

Important Points

  • The Andhra Pradesh government has pledged to make the state a 100% natural farming State by 2047.
  • The Food Planet Prize recognition reflects the alignment of government policy, scientific knowledge, and community institutions.

questions.text: The Depositor Education and Awareness (DEA) Fund in India, aimed at promoting depositor awareness, is maintained by which regulatory body?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is RBI.

In News

  • The Depositor Education and Awareness Fund is maintained by the Reserve Bank of India.

Key Points

  • The Reserve Bank of India maintains the Depositor Education and Awareness Fund using unclaimed deposits transferred from banks after 10 years of dormancy.
  • This fund supports initiatives to educate depositors on safe banking practices and financial literacy programs across India.
  • Banks must transfer the amount of unclaimed deposits along with interest to the DEA Fund on a quarterly basis as per RBI guidelines.
  • The RBI utilizes the fund for nationwide awareness campaigns, workshops, and materials to prevent fraud and enhance depositor protection.
  • Any claimant whose deposit is transferred to the fund can still approach their bank for reimbursement, which then recovers from the RBI.
  • The DEA Fund was established under Section 26A of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, to ensure public money benefits education efforts.
  • As of recent updates, the fund has grown significantly, enabling expanded RBI-led financial literacy drives in rural and urban areas.

Additional Information

  • Reserve Bank of India serves as India's central bank regulating monetary policy and banking operations.
    • Established in - 1935
    • HQ - Mumbai
    • Governor - Sanjay Malhotra
  • Unclaimed deposits refer to balances in inactive accounts where the depositor has not transacted for over 10 years.
  • RBI's financial literacy centers operate nationwide to disseminate knowledge on banking products and risks.
  • The fund excludes amounts from current accounts, foreign currency deposits, and certain exempted categories.
  • Banks report unclaimed deposit data to RBI annually for transparency and monitoring purposes.

questions.text: What is the primary objective of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed between the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) on May 5, 2026?

options.text: Establishing a joint sovereign wealth fund for infrastructure projects
Creating a unified maritime security framework for the South China Sea
Promoting cooperation in financial innovation and digital payments
Setting up a bilateral trade corridor for agricultural exports
Developing a unified physical credit card network for bilateral commodity trade

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Promoting cooperation in financial innovation and digital payments

In News

  • On May 5, 2026, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to strengthen bilateral cooperation in the financial sector.

Key Points

  • The core focus of the MoU is to promote cooperation in financial innovation and digital payments.
  • It includes information sharing, regulatory coordination, and the development of payment system connectivity for cross-border QR Code-based merchant payments.
  • The agreement aims to facilitate real-time, cost-efficient, and transparent cross-border transactions between India and Vietnam.
  • The other options, such as sovereign wealth funds, maritime security, or agricultural corridors, are not mentioned as objectives of this specific MoU between the two central banks.

Additional Information

  • The MoU was signed by the Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India and the Deputy Governor of the State Bank of Vietnam.
  • The agreement received the formal approval of the Union Cabinet prior to the signing.
  • The scope covers emerging market trends, standards, and best practices in digital payments and innovative technologies.

Important Points

  • This partnership is expected to position India as a major fintech hub and enhance trade and tourism between the two nations.
  • The framework envisages a mechanism for cooperation and information exchange in the area of fast payment systems, messaging systems, and card switches.

questions.text: Which ministry's services have been proposed as a new addition to the focus sectors under the NeSDA 2025 assessment framework?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Ministry of Corporate Affairs

In News

  • The Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) launched the portal for the National e-Governance Service Delivery Assessment (NeSDA) 2025 on May 28, 2026.

Key Points

  • Expansion of Scope: The framework for NeSDA 2025 proposes an expansion of focus sectors with the specific addition of services from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.
  • Service Coverage: In the 2025 cycle, a total of 59 mandatory services will be assessed for every State & UT, and 43 services will be assessed for Central Ministries/Departments.
  • Sectoral Focus: The framework already covers sectors such as Finance, Labour & Employment, Education, Local Governance, Social Welfare, Environment, Tourism, and Transport.
  • Purpose: The assessment aims to measure the depth and effectiveness of online service delivery mechanisms from a citizen’s perspective.

Additional Information

  • Framework Basis: NeSDA is based on the Online Service Index (OSI) of the UN e-Government Survey and is customized for the Indian federal structure.
  • Frequency: It is a biennial assessment (conducted every two years) to benchmark e-Governance progress.
  • Portal Categories: Assessed portals are classified into State/UT/City/Central Ministry Portals and Service Portals.

Important Points

  • Assessment Parameters: Key parameters include Accessibility, Ease of Use, Information Security and Privacy, Integrated Service Delivery, Open Government Data (OGD), and Leveraging Emerging Technologies.
  • Digital Governance: NeSDA helps in identifying gaps and promoting best practices to improve the user experience for citizens accessing public services online.

questions.text: According to the data released by the Commerce Ministry, what was the total value of India's merchandise exports during the cumulative period of April-May 2026-27?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is $88.91 billion

  • India's merchandise exports registered a significant growth in May 2026, while the trade deficit widened due to higher imports.

  • Imports in May 2026 grew by 20.62 per cent to reach $73.41 billion.
  • The trade deficit for May 2026 was recorded at $28.21 billion.
  • Hence, the value of $88.91 billion specifically refers to the cumulative exports for the April-May period of the 2026-27 fiscal year.

Additional Information

  • West Asia Trade: Exports to West Asia in May 2026 saw a marginal decline, reaching $5.30 billion compared to $5.38 billion in May 2025.
  • The data was provided by Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal.

  • Cumulative Export Growth (April-May): 16.09%.

questions.text: DigiLocker, a flagship initiative under the Digital India program aimed at providing citizens with a secure platform to store and access important documents digitally, is developed by which organisation responsible for promoting e-governance in India?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is National e-Governance Division (NeGD).

In News

  • DigiLocker, under the Digital India program, is developed and managed by the National e-Governance Division (NeGD) to provide a secure digital document storage and sharing platform for Indian citizens.

Key Points

  • DigiLocker is a key initiative of the Government of India’s Digital India program launched to empower citizens with digital document management.
  • The platform enables storage, access, and sharing of government-issued documents and certificates in a digital locker linked to the Aadhaar identity.
  • It is developed and maintained by the National e-Governance Division (NeGD), an autonomous arm under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
  • The National e-Governance Division (NeGD) also provides technical and policy support to various e-governance projects across India.
  • DigiLocker enhances citizen convenience by eliminating the need for physical document submission during various services.
  • The initiative promotes paperless governance, improves transparency, and facilitates secure data exchange among departments.
  • DigiLocker complies with security standards and includes features like digital signatures and secure access.

Additional Information

  • National e-Governance Division (NeGD) operates under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), India.
  • DigiLocker leverages Aadhaar-based authentication to provide secure access to documents.
  • The platform supports digital sharing of documents with government and private agencies, reducing fraud risk.
  • NeGD also oversees other e-governance initiatives like the Common Services Centres (CSC) and e-District projects.
  • DigiLocker was launched in 2015 and has since expanded to include over hundreds of government departments and private service providers.

questions.text: According to the World Bank assessment released in June 2026, what is the projected GDP growth rate for India for the year 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 6.6%

In News

  • The World Bank has released its updated global growth forecast, maintaining India as the world's fastest-growing major economy despite a downgrade in the global outlook.

Key Points

  • India's Growth: The World Bank projected India's GDP growth at 6.6% for the year 2026. This follows a 7% expansion projected for 2025.
  • Global Growth: The lender cut the global growth forecast for 2026 to 2.5%, primarily due to geopolitical tensions and the conflict in the Middle East involving Iran.
  • Comparison with China: While India is expected to grow at 6.6%, China's economy is forecast to grow at 4.2% in 2026.
  • Risk Factors: The report warns that global growth could further slow to 1.3% if energy supply disruptions, particularly related to the Strait of Hormuz, intensify.

Additional Information

  • Oil Price Assumptions: The baseline scenario assumes Brent crude oil prices will average $94 per barrel this year, a 36% increase from 2025 levels.
  • Regional Slump: The MENA (Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan, and Pakistan) region's growth forecast was slashed to 1.6% for 2026, down from 4% in 2025.
  • Major Economies: Growth in the United States is forecast at 2.2%, the euro zone at 0.8%, and Japan at 0.7% for 2026.

Important Points

  • World Bank Chief Economist Indermit Gill stated that India is expected to remain a high-growth economy for the next two decades.
  • The World Bank highlighted that the global economy today is less resilient than it was in 2008 or 2018 due to persistent policy uncertainty and high interest rates.

questions.text: What is the primary objective of the eight-member 'Q-SAFE' committee recently constituted by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)?

options.text: To establish a national cryptocurrency framework for inter-bank settlements
To evaluate quantum technology risks and recommend a roadmap for a secure financial ecosystem
To mandate the transition of all digital payments to a quantum-linked blockchain network
To design a quantum-powered firewall exclusively for the Reserve Bank's internal data centers
To oversee the installation of biometric verification hardware across physical ATMs

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is To evaluate quantum technology risks and recommend a roadmap for a secure financial ecosystem

In News

  • The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has formed the Q-SAFE committee to assess quantum technology risks and evaluate the financial sector's preparedness.

Key Points

  • Q-SAFE: The acronym stands for Quantum Secure and Adaptive Financial Ecosystem.
  • Primary Objective: The eight-member expert committee is tasked with exploring the potential benefits, risks, and challenges of quantum technology in the financial sector. It will specifically recommend a roadmap and framework to secure the Indian financial system.
  • Risk Assessment: The panel will examine vulnerabilities in existing cryptographic systems and evaluate the cryptographic inventory through a Cryptography Bill of Materials (CBOM).
  • Preparedness: It will assess industry preparedness for adopting quantum-safe cryptography, including the maturity of vendor tools. Hence, the correct answer focuses on risk evaluation and the creation of a secure roadmap.

Additional Information

  • Composition: The committee includes members like Anil Prabhakar (IIT Madras), Sunil Kumar (DST), Satish Rao Nagesh (SBI), and Dilip Asbe (NPCI).
  • Timeline: The committee is expected to submit its report within six months of its first meeting.
  • Quantum Mechanics: Quantum technology leverages principles such as superposition and entanglement to solve complex financial problems like portfolio optimization and risk assessment.

Important Points

  • Cryptographic Standards: A major concern cited by the RBI is that quantum technologies could undermine certain existing cryptographic standards currently used to protect financial data.
  • Cross-country Analysis: The panel will also undertake a cross-country analysis and assess the adequacy of regulatory frameworks for quantum application deployment.

questions.text: What was the total gross Goods and Services Tax (GST) collection recorded in May 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is ₹1.94 lakh crore

In News

  • Gross GST collections in May 2026 rose by 3.2% to exceed ₹1.94 lakh crore.

Key Points

  • ₹1.94 lakh crore: This was the total gross GST collection reported for the month of May 2026, driven by improved supplies and imports.
  • ₹1.88 lakh crore: This represents the gross GST collection recorded in the same month of the previous year (May 2025).
  • ₹1.67 lakh crore: This was the net GST revenue in May 2026 after adjusting for refunds, showing a 3.3% growth.
  • ₹2.43 lakh crore: This figure refers to the all-time high GST mop-up recorded in April 2026.

Additional Information

  • Breakdown of May 2026 collections: CGST stood at ₹37,397 crore, SGST at ₹45,143 crore, and IGST at ₹51,990 crore from domestic transactions.
  • IGST from imports rose by 19.1% to reach ₹59,654 crore, indicating an expansion in industrial capacity.
  • GST refunds during this period grew by 2.6% to ₹27,281 crore.

Important Points

  • The taxable supplies of goods grew significantly by 26.9%, reflecting strong domestic demand.
  • The services sector saw a growth of 22.2% in taxable supplies, demonstrating structural resilience in domestic consumption.

questions.text: Which nodal laboratory of the Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO) was primarily responsible for the indigenous development of the RudraM-II Air-to-Surface Missile?

options.text: Combat Vehicles Research and Development Establishment (CVRDE)

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Research Centre Imarat (RCI), Hyderabad

In News

  • The Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO) and the Indian Air Force (IAF) successfully conducted flight-tests of the RudraM-II Air-to-Surface Missile from an airborne platform.

Key Points

  • The RudraM-II has been indigenously developed by the Research Centre Imarat (RCI), Hyderabad, serving as the nodal DRDO laboratory for this project.
  • The development was carried out in collaboration with sister laboratories, including the Defence Research and Development Laboratory (DRDL), High Energy Materials Research Laboratory (HEMRL), and Armament Research & Development Establishment (ARDE).
  • The missile tests were conducted under extreme release conditions, and it successfully hit a predefined target with pin-point accuracy.
  • Flight data for the mission was captured by range instruments at the Integrated Test Range (ITR), Chandipur.

Additional Information

  • Significant contributions were made by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), Regional Centre for Military Airworthiness, and the Missile System Quality Assurance Agency.
  • Development cum Production Partners (DcPPs) and various private industries also played a crucial role in the missile's development and testing.

Important Points

  • The successful test demonstrates the maturity of indigenous defence technologies and supports the Aatmanirbharta (self-reliance) initiative in advanced weapon systems.
  • The RudraM-II is an Air-to-Surface Missile, a critical component for the Indian Air Force's offensive capabilities.

questions.text: According to the announcement by the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, the base year for the Wholesale Price Index (WPI) has been revised from 2011–12 to which of the following years?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 2022–23

In News

  • The Ministry of Commerce & Industry announced that the competent authority approved the revision of the Base Year of the Wholesale Price Index (WPI) from 2011-12 to 2022-23 on May 25, 2026.

Key Points

  • The Office of Economic Adviser, DPIIT, will release the revised series of WPI with the base year 2022-23 on June 15, 2026.
  • The new series will replace the existing series that used 2011-12 as the base year.
  • The number of items in the WPI basket has been increased from 697 to 957 in the new 2022-23 series.
  • The transition aims to align price measurement with current economic realities and global best practices recommended by the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

Additional Information

  • Along with WPI, the government is introducing Producer Price Indices (PPIs), including Output PPI, Input PPI, and Service PPI for seven specific services.
  • The Service PPI covers sectors like Banking, Securities Transaction, Insurance, Management of Pension Funds, Railways, Air (Passenger), and Telecom.
  • New and renewable energy sources such as Solar, Wind, and Nuclear electricity have been added to the 'Electricity' group in the revised WPI.
  • Crude Petroleum and Natural Gas have been shifted from 'Primary Articles' to the 'Fuel and Power' group for better alignment.

Important Points

  • The revised WPI will be released for five years alongside the PPI to allow users to switch between the indices before WPI is eventually discontinued.
  • The methodology for weights has shifted from Net Traded Value to Gross Value of Output (GVO), which better reflects domestic production significance.
  • A Linking Factor based on the financial year 2024-25 will be provided to connect the old and new series.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'PFRDA Pension Sahayak' portal:

A. It is an AI-powered platform that supports 22 Indian languages and enables voice-based grievance submission for pension subscribers.
B. The platform includes an automated escalation mechanism for grievances that are not resolved within the prescribed timelines.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?

Select the code for the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: The platform is exclusively available to government employees and does not cater to private sector pension subscribers.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Both A and B

In News

  • The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) has launched an AI-enabled grievance redressal platform called 'PFRDA Pension Sahayak' to enhance digital transformation in the pension sector.

Key Points

  • Statement A is correct: The 'PFRDA Pension Sahayak' platform integrates with Bhashini to support 22 Indian languages. It allows for voice-based grievance filing, specifically designed to make pension services more accessible for senior citizens and rural subscribers.
  • Statement B is correct: A key functional feature of the portal is the automated escalation mechanism. This ensures that any grievances not resolved within the prescribed timelines are automatically escalated to higher levels, thereby increasing accountability and ensuring timely resolution.

Additional Information

  • The platform aligns with the principles of accessibility, transparency, and accountability as envisioned under the Centre's NextGen CPGRAMS.
  • Subscribers can receive responses in their preferred regional language and utilize audio-based communication for better inclusivity.

Important Points

  • The initiative marks a significant step toward citizen-centric digital governance.
  • It integrates multiple pension service touchpoints into a single, unified digital ecosystem.
  • The PFRDA is the primary regulatory body overseeing these enhancements for pension subscribers across India.

questions.text: What is the annual interest rate offered by Federal Bank on its newly launched 'FCNR Max Deposit Scheme' for US dollar-denominated deposits?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 6.25% per annum

questions.text: To which African country is the 51st locomotive engine, manufactured at the Marhowrah plant in Bihar, being exported under the 'Make in India' initiative?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Guinea

In News

  • Union Minister of Railways Ashwini Vaishnaw announced a record railway budget of over Rs 10,000 crore for Bihar and highlighted the state's growing role in global exports.

Key Points

  • The Minister noted that Bihar has become a hub for global locomotive exports under the 'Make in India' initiative.
  • The 51st locomotive engine manufactured at the Marhowrah plant in Bihar is scheduled to be exported to the African nation of Guinea.
  • The export signifies the technical capability and manufacturing strength of the railway sector in the state of Bihar.
  • Other options like Ethiopia, Nigeria, and Sudan are incorrect as the specific news report mentions only Guinea as the recipient of the 51st locomotive.

Additional Information

  • Total ongoing railway projects in Bihar are valued at approximately Rs 1.15 lakh crore.
  • A new station with five new platforms is being developed at Hardinge Park in the Patna area to increase capacity.
  • A new express train service has been launched connecting Chhapra to Delhi, fulfilling a long-standing demand of the region.
  • Development projects are also underway at Fatuha near Patna.

Important Points

  • The railway budget allocation for Bihar (Rs 10,000 crore) represents a record high for the state's rail infrastructure development.
  • The Marhowrah plant is a critical facility for the production of high-capacity locomotives intended for both domestic use and international export.

questions.text: Who emerged as the winner of the 2026 Scripps National Spelling Bee title after a dramatic 90-second lightning-round tiebreaker?

questions.text: As per the revised guidelines issued by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) in June 2026, what is one of the primary objectives of the overhauled Lead Bank Scheme (LBS)?

options.text: Enhancing the flow of credit to priority sectors for inclusive growth
Automating the credit appraisal process for large corporate borrowers
Phasing out the role of Lead District Managers in rural areas
Establishing a centralized tax collection system for rural businesses
Implementing a uniform interest rate for all types of loans across districts.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Enhancing the flow of credit to priority sectors for inclusive growth

In News

  • The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has overhauled the Lead Bank Scheme (LBS) through revised guidelines issued on June 19, 2026, following a comprehensive review of the scheme.

Key Points

  • The RBI stated that the revamped Lead Bank Scheme seeks to achieve two key objectives: enhancing the flow of credit to priority sectors for achieving inclusive growth and deepening financial inclusion through improved access and usage of financial services.
  • Under the new framework, a Lead Bank in every district will coordinate the efforts of banks, government agencies, and other institutions to improve credit flow and promote financial inclusion.
  • The revised guidelines mandate every Lead Bank to appoint a Lead District Manager (LDM) to exclusively oversee and coordinate the scheme's implementation in the district.
  • A three-tier structure comprising Block Level Bankers' Committees, District Consultative Committees, and State Level Bankers' Committees (SLBCs) has been introduced to strengthen coordination.

Additional Information

  • The Lead Bank Scheme was originally introduced by the RBI in December 1969.
  • Historically, the scheme has played a vital role in branch expansion, deposit mobilisation, and lending in rural and semi-urban regions across India.
  • The 2026 guidelines supersede all earlier instructions issued by the Reserve Bank of India regarding the LBS.

Important Points

  • The District-level committees are tasked with preparing and reviewing District Credit Plans and resolving operational issues related to implementation.
  • The review process for these new guidelines included examining public feedback received on a draft framework released earlier in the year.

questions.text: Which organization has partnered with Punjab National Bank (PNB) to launch biodegradable co-branded twin credit cards to target the younger consumer segment?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd

In News

  • Punjab National Bank (PNB) has partnered with Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd to launch biodegradable co-branded twin credit cards.

Key Points

  • Partnership: The public sector lender PNB has collaborated with Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd to strengthen its presence in India's underpenetrated credit card market.
  • Sustainability: The cards are manufactured using biodegradable materials, aligning with eco-friendly and sustainable practices.
  • Twin-Card Proposition: Customers will have access to both Visa and RuPay networks through this single offering, combining global acceptance with UPI-enabled convenience.
  • Target Audience: The initiative specifically targets Gen Z and Millennials, who represent a significant growth opportunity for the bank.
  • Logic: While other options like Razorpay, Pine Labs, and BharatPe are prominent fintech players, the news specifically mentions Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Ltd as the partner for this launch.

Additional Information

  • Leadership: The launch was announced by Ashok Chandra, MD and CEO of PNB, and Avinash Ramesh Godkhindi, MD and CEO of Zaggle.
  • Accessibility: The cards will be available through the zagg.money application.
  • Benefits: The cards offer perks such as railway and airport lounge access, OTT subscriptions, fuel surcharge waivers, and a 1.5 per cent discount on jewellery purchases.

Important Points

  • The PNB-Zaggle twin card combines the global travel privileges of Visa with the lifestyle benefits and UPI convenience of RuPay.
  • The partnership aims to accelerate customer acquisition and enhance engagement through robust digital infrastructure and streamlined onboarding.

questions.text: In May 2026, which Indian Air Force strategic airlift aircraft was utilized to transport the sacred relics of Arahant Sariputta and Arahant Mahamoggallana to Mongolia?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is IL-76 Gajraj

In News

  • The Indian Air Force (IAF) airlifted the sacred Buddhist relics of Arahant Sariputta and Arahant Mahamoggallana to Mongolia in May 2026.

Key Points

  • On 30 May 2026, an Indian Air Force IL-76 strategic airlift aircraft, known as Gajraj, transported the relics from Delhi to Mongolia.
  • The aircraft undertook an overnight flight and landed in Mongolia at 1125 hrs IST.
  • This mission was conducted to support India's efforts to strengthen cultural ties with friendly nations.
  • The use of the IL-76 Gajraj reflects the IAF's capability to support national objectives and global cultural outreach. Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

Additional Information

  • The relics belong to Arahant Sariputta and Arahant Mahamoggallana, who were the chief disciples of Gautama Buddha.
  • The mission highlights the intersection of military logistics and cultural diplomacy.

Important Points

  • The IL-76 is a heavy-duty strategic aircraft used by the IAF for large-scale transport operations.
  • The initiative aligns with India's broader Act East policy and cultural engagement with Buddhist nations.

questions.text: Who has been nominated by the Central government as a Director on the Central Board of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and State Bank of India (SBI) with effect from June 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Sanjay Lohiya

In News

  • The Central government has nominated Sanjay Lohiya as a Director on the Central Boards of the RBI and SBI.

Key Points

  • Sanjay Lohiya: He is currently serving as the Secretary of the Department of Financial Services (DFS) under the Ministry of Finance. He assumed this role on June 1, 2026.
  • Nomination: He has been nominated as a Director on the Central Board of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the State Bank of India (SBI) with immediate effect and until further orders.
  • Reason for Vacancy: His nomination follows the superannuation of Nagaraju Maddirala, who retired as the DFS Secretary on May 31, 2026.
  • Comparison with Options: Nagaraju Maddirala is the predecessor who superannuated. Rajiv Mani and Manoj Govil are not the individuals nominated for these specific board positions according to the news provided.

Additional Information

  • The Department of Financial Services (DFS) oversees the functioning of public sector banks, financial institutions, and insurance companies in India.
  • The Central Board of the RBI is the primary body responsible for the overall direction of the central bank's affairs.
  • The State Bank of India (SBI) is the country's largest commercial bank, and its board includes government nominees to ensure regulatory and policy alignment.

Important Points

  • Sanjay Lohiya succeeds Nagaraju Maddirala as a Director on the boards of RBI and SBI.
  • The appointment is effective from June 2026 following his takeover as DFS Secretary.

questions.text: BSE Index Services recently launched the BSE Saatvik 100, India's first index designed to promote ethical and value-based investing. According to the index composition, which specific sector has been identified as the single-largest contributor with a weight of 37.55%?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Financial Services

In News

  • BSE Index Services Pvt. Ltd. announced the launch of BSE Saatvik 100, which is India's first Saatvik Index aimed at promoting value-based and ethical investing.

Key Points

  • The Financial Services sector holds the highest weight in the BSE Saatvik 100 Index at 37.55%, making it the single-largest contributor.
  • The index is derived from the constituents of the BSE 500 Index that align with ethical and value-based principles.
  • Following Financial Services, the next major sectors are Consumer Discretionary and Energy.
  • Among individual stocks, HDFC Bank holds the largest weight, followed by ICICI Bank and Reliance Industries.
  • The launch aligns with the growing interest in Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) investing in India.

Additional Information

  • BSE Index Services, formerly known as Asia Index, is a wholly owned subsidiary of BSE that manages various indices including the Sensex.
  • The index can be used for passive investment strategies such as Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) and index funds.

Important Points

  • The word "Saatvik" in the index name signifies purity, responsibility, and ethical conduct in investment decisions.
  • Other key sectors included in the index are commodities, industrials, utilities, telecommunication, services, FMCG, and healthcare.
